// genvec writes cross-language test vectors for the ROS 2 bridge (H3): command envelopes
// built and signed exactly as policy.Service.publishCommandID does, with policy.Signer,
// policy.ParamsHash and policy.Canonicalize. The key is derived from a public test label,
// not a secret: sha256("onemind-h3-test-vector") is the ed25519 seed.
package main

import (
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/onemindos/omos/services/policy/internal/policy"
)

func main() {
	seed := sha256.Sum256([]byte("onemind-h3-test-vector"))
	key := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seed[:])
	signer := &policy.Signer{Key: key, KID: "policy-1"}
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 29, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	ts := func(t time.Time) string { return t.UTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05.000Z") }
	type vec struct {
		Name      string          `json:"name"`
		Subject   string          `json:"subject"`
		Envelope  json.RawMessage `json:"envelope"`
		Hash      string          `json:"params_hash"`
		JCS       string          `json:"jcs_without_sig"`
	}
	cases := []struct {
		name, verb, level string
		params            string
		approvers         []string
	}{
		{"goto", "goto", "A3", `{"lat":30.2672,"lon":-97.7431,"hae_m":150.25,"speed_mps":0.5}`, []string{"user:zeus"}},
		{"goto-unicode-reason", "goto", "A3", `{"lat":-0.000001,"lon":1e-7,"hae_m":0}`, []string{"user:zeus"}},
		{"hold", "hold", "A3", `{"duration_s":30,"reason":"wait é ✓"}`, []string{"user:zeus"}},
		{"rtl", "rtl", "A3", `{}`, []string{"user:alice"}},
		{"estop", "estop", "A3", `{}`, []string{"user:zeus"}},
		{"estop_release", "estop_release", "A4", `{}`, []string{"user:zeus", "user:alice"}},
	}
	var out struct {
		Generator string `json:"generator"`
		PublicKey string `json:"public_key_b64"`
		Kid       string `json:"kid"`
		Now       string `json:"now"`
		Vectors   []vec  `json:"vectors"`
	}
	out.Generator = "omos feat/policy-service (PR #554) policy.Signer/ParamsHash/Canonicalize via a throwaway cmd/genvec; see tests/fixtures/README.md"
	out.PublicKey = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(key.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey))
	out.Kid = "policy-1"
	out.Now = ts(now)
	for i, c := range cases {
		subject := "cmd.fleet.robot.sim-tb1." + c.verb
		hash, err := policy.ParamsHash("asset."+c.verb, 1, policy.Target{EntityType: "robot", EntityID: "sim-tb1"}, json.RawMessage(c.params))
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		var d any
		_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(c.params), &d)
		apps := []policy.Approval{}
		for j, a := range c.approvers {
			apps = append(apps, policy.Approval{By: a, At: ts(now.Add(-time.Duration(2-j) * time.Second)), Step: j + 1})
		}
		id := []string{"6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c1e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b60", "6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c1e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b61",
			"6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c1e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b62", "6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c1e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b63",
			"6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c1e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b64", "6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c1e-9a52-1d2e3f4a5b65"}[i]
		env := map[string]any{
			"v": 1, "id": id, "ts": ts(now), "cmd": subject, "source": "service:policy", "subject": subject, "data": d,
			"action_id":  "act-01jbtestvector0000000000" + string(rune('a'+i)),
			"expires_at": ts(now.Add(30 * time.Second)),
			"simulated":  true,
			"approval": map[string]any{"required": true, "status": "approved", "approver": c.approvers[len(c.approvers)-1],
				"reason": "", "level": c.level, "params_hash": hash, "approvals": apps},
			"policy": map[string]any{"decision_id": "dec-test" + c.name, "allowed": true},
			"corr":   "0d6b1f8e-6a3c-4b9e-8f21-7c5d4e3b2a10",
		}
		jcs, err := policy.Canonicalize(env)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if err := signer.Sign(env); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(env)
		if err := policy.VerifyCommand(key.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey), b); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		out.Vectors = append(out.Vectors, vec{Name: c.name, Subject: subject, Envelope: b, Hash: hash, JCS: string(jcs)})
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	_ = enc.Encode(out)
}
